test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

People write autobiographies for various reasons.

options.text: Autobiographies have been written by people for various reasons.
Autobiographies were written by people for various reasons.
Autobiographies are written by people for various reasons.
Autobiographies are being written by people for various reasons.

solution: ​The correct answer is **'****Autobiographies are written by people for various reasons'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the question we have to change it into Passive Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • The subject of the given sentence is 'People'. • The object of the given sentence is 'Autobiographies'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • 'write' will be changed into 'are written'. Correct Sentence:__* Autobiographies are written by people for various reasons.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • *Subject + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)* • *Subject (Objective Case) + is/am/are + V3 + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice) * • *Example:* • *Aastha teaches English. (Active Voice) * • *English is taught by Aastha. (Passive Voice)* • दिए गए वाक्य का **Subject** 'People' है और दिए गए वाक्य का **object** 'Autobiographies' है। • वस्तु के स्थान पर विषय रखा जाएगा और विषय के स्थान पर वस्तु रखी जाएगी। • और 'write' को 'are written' में बदल दिया जाएगा। • अंत में, Preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा। 111:T7b5, The correct answer is '**Provided**'.
